slides.texte_overlay:
self taught skills that
make you stand out

cooking without recipes

learn the basics of flavour and you'll never need a recipe again. people who can cook from whatever's in the fridge always seem calm and so capable at home.

writing clearly

practise writing short, clear messages and emails. clear writing is rare, and it quietly makes people trust your judgement in everything else you ever do.

general knowledge

knowing a little about everything makes you stand out in any room, and you can teach yourself in just a few minutes a day. curious generalists are welcome in every conversation.
slides.texte_sophia:
general knowledge

i taught myself general knowledge, 5 minutes a day with one lesson in the Sophia app: art, history, science. now i can join almost any conversation and add something.

slides.texte_overlay:
public speaking

record yourself talking for two minutes about anything, then watch it back. a few weeks of this and you'll speak more calmly than most people around you.

basic first aid

learn simple first aid from free videos and practise the steps. being the calm person who knows what to do in a crisis is a skill everyone deeply respects.
